_source: ref_docs/brand/colors-and-fonts.jpg, from the ESE brand kit (Drive export ESE 🐢-20260826T071706Z-1-001.zip). The sheet is an image, so these values are TRANSCRIBED, not parsed. This file is the single source of truth for scripts/brand-lint.mjs — correct it here if the kit changes, never in the lint.
neutralRule: The two starred swatches replace black and white 'whenever possible, including text and backgrounds'. So #ffffff and #000000 must not appear as COLOUR values.

subheading.trackingNote: the kit says +25; Adobe tracking is 1/1000 em

#ffffff.reason: Google's sign-in button and the SERP preview imitate Google's UI, not ESE's

hueToleranceNote: A derived tint or shade is allowed if its hue is within this many degrees of a kit colour. Greys along the ink/navy axis and alpha compositions of the two neutrals are the intended use.
allowedExceptionsNote: An exception is granted to a SELECTOR, not to a colour. #ffffff is allowed on Google's button; it is not allowed anywhere else, which is the whole point of the kit's neutral rule.
